scope: ArduCopter GCS failsafe state and action chain

observed_chain.fact: The Copter scheduler registers three_hz_loop at 3 Hz, and three_hz_loop calls failsafe_gcs_check.
failsafe_gcs_check returns when FS_GCS_ENABLE is disabled or when no designated GCS traffic has ever been recorded.
The check computes unsigned elapsed milliseconds from the recorded GCS timestamp and converts FS_GCS_TIMEOUT seconds to a clamped uint32 millisecond threshold.
State recovery uses elapsed < timeout and state activation uses elapsed > timeout; the equality case has no explicit transition branch.
set_failsafe_gcs writes both failsafe.gcs and AP_Notify::flags.failsafe_gcs.
An accepted MAVLink HEARTBEAT refreshes the designated-GCS timestamp through sysid_mygcs_seen.
The accepted GCS system-ID predicate is parameterized by MAV_GCS_SYSID and MAV_GCS_SYSID_HI, supporting either one ID or an inclusive range.
Accepted RC override and MANUAL_CONTROL traffic can also refresh the GCS timestamp; heartbeat absence alone is therefore not equivalent to timestamp staleness in every execution.
The failsafe state transition and the resulting vehicle action are distinct: action selection additionally consults FS_GCS_ENABLE, armed/landed state, flight mode, battery state, and FS_OPTIONS.

The existing GCSFailsafe autotest changes MAV_GCS_SYSID, FS_GCS_ENABLE, FS_OPTIONS, FS_GCS_TIMEOUT, and heartbeat rate, providing future behavioral-oracle candidates but no result was executed in this task.
